body.x: Lepow(lepowglobal.com) showed off its bluetooth speaker ‘Mod’ at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
The Mod is an interesting design. It is inspired by record players from the 1960s and incorporates today's latest technology such as Bluetooth 4.0, 360-degree surround sound and four sound modes.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
